---
title: "Page-level open-graph and twitter-card"
description: "Page description"
open-graph:
  title: "OG title"
  locale: fr_FR
twitter-card:
  card-style: summary
  creator: "@creator"
  site: "@site"
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:title" content="OG title">'
          - '<meta property="og:locale" content="fr_FR">'
          - '<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary">'
          - '<meta name="twitter:creator" content="@creator">'
          - '<meta name="twitter:site" content="@site">'
---

Page front matter enables both providers without any `website:` setting, and every option it sets passes validation and reaches the output.
